event: first use of the user-mediated root transfer procedure

predecessor.compaction_basis: zero compactMetadata records in the transcript, re-checked after the transfer

mechanism.claim: a root's context is carrying cost, paid on every coordination call and doing no bulk work, which is why transfer pays back almost at once

support.baseline_comparison: the pure-Codex baseline records ~73% cached re-send at 126-144K context per call; the root at 648K was at 87.8%

contrast_with_worker_handoff.worker: the handoff_threshold replay over Codex builder traces found break-even restart at about 75K, and at the measured 116K floor every threshold lost about 30%
contrast_with_worker_handoff.reading: the asymmetry is expected under the mechanism above: a worker's context is mostly task-essential reading a successor must redo, while a root's is re-sent state. Stated as the proposed reading of two measurements on different hosts and roles, not as a measured causal claim.
contrast_with_worker_handoff.caveat: different hosts (Codex builders vs a Claude root) and different roles; not a like-for-like comparison

procedure_compliance.quiescent: all 28 predecessor subagents finished; no child crossed the boundary; no board claims held
procedure_compliance.handoff_written: root-handoff-v2.md, superseding v1 with v1's sha256 recorded

corrections.claim: the root handoff states the transfer reason as 'about 580K context at a quiescent boundary'
corrections.class: a reading stated from recollection rather than from the transcript at the moment of writing
corrections.consequence: none to the decision, which was correct in direction; the recorded reason understates the pressure by about 76K
corrections.check: max of input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens over the transcript

harness_note.observation: the predecessor reached 656,196 context with no auto-compaction
harness_note.significance: the 202,533 floor recorded elsewhere in these probes is the minimum of 21 observed auto-compactions, not a ceiling. A session can run far above it without compacting, so that figure bounds where compaction has been seen and does not predict where it fires.
harness_note.window_fraction: not established: Claude Code transcripts record no context window

limits: the successor had completed 34 calls when this was recorded; its per-call mean will move as it takes on coordination load

break-even uses the predecessor's last-20-call mean as the counterfactual cost of continuing, which assumes its context would not have grown further. It would have, so 1.4 calls is an upper bound on the payback period.
